title: NASA Cancels Its Rescue Mission for the Aging Swift Telescope
summary: The LINK probe was supposed to use robotic arms to capture Swift and lift it into a safe orbit. Problems with its control system forced NASA to call off the attempt.
llm_summary: NASA has scrapped the planned rescue of the aging Swift space telescope, which would have involved the LINK probe using robotic arms to capture the satellite and boost it into a safer orbit. Engineers discovered critical flaws in LINK’s control system that made a reliable rendezvous impossible, prompting the agency to abort the mission. Swift will now continue operating in its current, deteriorating trajectory.
